wishlist.name: Immortal Justice
wishlist.summary: Modern SEED Action System, crisp colors without much correction, and a reliable building experience.

collection.name: Char's Zaku II (Revive)

latestReprint.note: Japan retailer December reproduction listing for HGUC #234, not older #32 or Origin version

collection.summary: A very safe modern classic: flexible joints, simple molded colors, and a beautifully restrained Zaku silhouette.
cons: More common and less unusual than top choices
Mono-eye uses sticker

collection.name: Gundam Vidar
collection.joints: Average; large armor needs care when posing
collection.summary: Pre-build verdict: a striking blue-and-black kit with a rifle, two pistols, Burst Saber and deployable foot blades. At roughly NT$400 it is a solid buy, though stickers and some paint are needed for accurate colors, and bulky side armor and backpack parts make posing fiddly.
pros: Distinctive blue-and-black silhouette with substantial side armor
Varied weapons, including dual pistols and deployable Hunter’s Edge blades
Good value around NT$400 for the included accessories
cons: White, red, gray and forearm details rely on stickers; some areas still need paint
Backpack binders and large side skirts can catch or come loose during posing
Visible seams and hollow areas on the backpack reward extra finishing work
